purpose: Teach: 蛇足/悪し/男前/わが子/惨め/見分ける/読み取る/老若男女

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、説明に蛇足はいらないって仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer said he didn't need any extra explanation.
lines.style: Gentle observation, as if sharing something she noticed. Warm tone, no judgment. Pause before the name — offering the thought as a small gift of perspective.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、悪しき習慣は早めに改めようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: So let's work on breaking that habit early, okay?
lines.style: Soft encouragement, not lecturing. Matter-of-fact but kind — the tone of someone who's already thought through why this matters. Steady eye contact, collaborative.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、男前のジャズ歌手だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer — he's a handsome jazz singer, did you know?
lines.style: Brightness in the voice, like she's sharing something delightful. Slight lean-in, a small smile underneath the words. Genuine pleasure in the detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、わが子のためにポイント貯めてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And he saves up his points for his own child.
lines.style: Tender recognition. Slower pace on 'own child' — letting that land. Voice softens almost imperceptibly. The kind of detail that changes how you see someone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ミスでお客様を惨めな気持ちにさせないようにしよう、メイちゃん
lines.en: So let's make sure a mistake never makes a customer feel small.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Not urgent — careful. The words settle into something that matters. Slight exhale before 'makes' — weight of care behind it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本物のコーヒー豆と粉を見分ける目が大事ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, having an eye for real beans versus ground — that's important.
lines.style: Practical observation with genuine respect underneath. Calm, measured. Not bossy — recognizing skill when she names it. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の表情を読み取る力をつけようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And learning to read what's happening in a customer's face — that's a real skill to build.
lines.style: Encouraging without pressure. Steady, affirming tone. Frames it as a learnable thing, not a failure. Small warmth at the name — inclusion.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、老若男女のお客様に愛されるお店にしよう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's make this place somewhere customers of all kinds want to come back to.
lines.style: Vision-building, not harsh. Warm finality — the kind of statement that feels like a shared goal. Slight lift at the end. Inclusive 'let's', not directive.
